svg.aria-label: 拖动滑条切换五档的动画
svg.text: Drag the slider — each tier explains itself on the right

g.text: No bookkeeping, no notices, no request changes.
Use this if you want it to behave as if uninstalled.
The system prompt forbids the empty verbs and hands out a template.
Price: a few dozen characters per request.
Not a single request byte changes ← the default
Cuts the generation once short lines pile up, then resumes via followup.
Nothing fake is ever written to the session log
Also cuts, but injects a read-only tool call to push the turn forward.
Price: one fake get_goal call lands in history.
The third loop in one turn kills that turn outright.
Price: a failed-run message, and that turn is lost.
Cannot be set globally ← it asks again every time
The harshest tier, and the easiest to regret.

svg.text: Collapsed, only the current step shows; press, drag or focus to expand.
Pull the handle up past 10px to lock it globally — the outline turns violet.
